messages:
lauren (AE): Hey team — Tactera Bank returned the SIG questionnaire (v2.1). They flagged ~10 items but called out controls around key management, admin MFA, and runtime isolation. Need a question-by-question evidence bundle by EOD Fri. Who can pick this up?
sam (security): I can own the KMS/admin MFA bits and review the final bundle. Need: SOC2 report (redacted OK), KMS rotation policy, key usage logs, and proof of HSM/KMS integration for Private deployments.
alex (infra): SOC2 is in Notion: https://notion.redwood/soc2-2025 (redacted). KMS policy lives in infra repo: `infra/security/kms-rotation.md`. I'll copy the latest snippet here and attach examples.
ben (eng-runtime): For runtime isolation they want separation between customer workloads. We have dedicated pools and tenant tagging — can provide our routing policy and a small nginx/proxy snippet. Example config: `service: inference; isolation: tenant-tagging; pool: dedicated-gpu-pool`.
mia (solutions): Also note Tactera specifically asked whether we support customer-managed keys in Private. We do (via customer KMS/HSM). Need a short statement + architecture diagram. I have a draft diagram in Figma: https://figma.redwood/tactera-kms-diagram (shareable).
sam (security): Great. For logs/audit: Alex, can you export CloudTrail/Stackdriver slices for the last 90 days showing key usage events and admin console role changes? CSV or PDF preferred.
alex (infra): Yup. I'll run a scoped export and drop to the sales S3 draft bucket: `s3://redwood-sales/tactera/sig/` — will prefix filenames with `redact_`.
ben (eng-runtime): I'll grab the runtime policy doc and create a 1-page evidence sheet describing batching isolation, kernel pinning, and tenant-level metrics.
sam (security): One more ask: admin console MFA screenshot and Okta sign-in policy. I have an Okta export but need the screenshot of the MFA settings page. @lauren can you confirm you have permission to access the Okta admin UI?
lauren (AE): I have access. I can take the screenshot and upload to the same S3 path.
lauren (AE): Timeline check — if we assemble by Thursday PM, can we have a quick security review Friday morning and ship by EOD?
sam (security): Yes, if artifacts are in S3 by Thu 6pm PST I can review Fri morning.
mia (solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing cover letter explaining each artifact mapping to SIG control IDs — will use the SIG template: https://templates.redwood/sig-response-template.md
sig-bot: Reminder — SIG response checklist created: https://internal.redwood/sig-checklist (auto-generated).
alex (infra): Uploaded partials: `redact_soc2_summary.pdf` and `kms_rotation_policy_v2.md` to `s3://redwood-sales/tactera/sig/` (links in the bucket, ping me if you need presigned URLs).
ben (eng-runtime): Uploaded runtime-isolation-sheet.pdf to the same path.
sam (security): I reviewed the KMS doc quick pass — please add the key rotation cadence (we do 90 days) explicitly and the emergency key compromise procedure. I'll leave inline comments on the doc in the repo.
lauren (AE): Awesome — I'll assemble zip and share presigned link once all files are in. Tagging follow-ups: @sam review final, @alex include audit export, @ben confirm runtime doc final. :thumbsup:
sam (security): Thanks all. Once I sign off I will add a short security statement for the cover letter confirming controls and scope.
lauren (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Tactera and book a 30m handoff call for Friday 11am PT if that works for everyone.
mia (solutions): Works for me.
ben (eng-runtime): Works.
alex (infra): Works.
sam (security): Works.
lauren (AE): Closing this thread for now — will post the presigned URL here when ready.
